attchmntText: Ceinsys Tech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026 -Outcome of the meeting of Board of Directors of the Company held on Thursday, November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ceinsys Tech Ltd board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 14,816 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 29,606 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Profit before tax was 5,628 lakhs for the quarter and 9,848 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 20.15 rupees for the quarter and 35.08 rupees for the half year. The board approved the change in designation of CA Richa Jain from Deputy Chief Financial Officer to Chief Financial Officer effective November 12, 2026. In principle approval was granted for establishing a wholly owned subsidiary in the United Arab Emirates. Mr. Bala Pavan Kumar Tsunduru was appointed as President and Senior Management effective December 7, 2026. Key managerial personnel were authorized to determine material events.

attchmntText: Ceinsys Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Ceinsys Tech Limited has scheduled a conference call for Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 11:30 AM IST to discuss the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The management team includes Mr. Kaushik Khona, Dr. Abhay Kimmatkar, and Richa Jain. Participants may dial in using the provided universal dial-in numbers or join via the Express Join link. Attendees are requested to connect 5 to 10 minutes prior to the scheduled time. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Ceinsys Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about Incorporation of Joint Venture Company.
